body.zh-Hant: 生於格魯吉亞的哥里，父為鞋匠、母為洗衣婦，11歲才學俄語。1894年進入第比利斯東正教神學院，1898年成為俄國社會民主工黨黨員，1899年因參與革命活動被神學院開除；1912年列寧召他進入布爾什維克中央委員會。LeMO 載生日為1878年12月18日，另說1879年12月21日。
body.en: Born in Gori, Georgia, to a cobbler and a washerwoman, he learned Russian only at eleven. He entered the Orthodox seminary in Tiflis in 1894, became a member of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party in 1898 and was expelled from the seminary in 1899 for revolutionary activity; in 1912 Lenin called him onto the Bolshevik central committee. LeMO gives 18 December 1878 as his birth date, or 21 December 1879 by other accounts.

body.zh-Hant: 列寧的布爾什維克政府成立後，他先任民族事務人民委員，後任工農檢查人民委員；1919年同時成為政治局與組織局委員，這使他在黨內擁有特殊權力基礎；1922年新設的總書記一職被他擴建成黨內權力的關鍵位置。
body.en: In Lenin's Bolshevik government he first became People's Commissar for Nationalities and later for the Workers' and Peasants' Inspectorate; in 1919 he became a member of both the Politburo and the Orgburo, giving him a special power base in the party; in 1922 he built the newly created post of General Secretary into the key to his power.

body.zh-Hant: 列寧去世後他保住各項職務，借助權位與結盟逐一排除對手、壓制黨內反對；1929年他以「一國社會主義」為準則推行強制農業集體化與嚴酷工業化。
body.en: After Lenin's death he kept his offices and, through his power and alliances, eliminated competitors one after another and suppressed internal opposition; in 1929 under 'socialism in one country' he pushed forced collectivisation and rigorous industrialisation.

body.zh-Hant: 1934至1939年的「大清洗」中他消滅一切潛在與被指的對手，包括列寧時代的老布爾什維克領導層；1939年蘇聯與德國簽互不侵犯條約；1941年他任人民委員會議主席，並在德軍入侵後接掌戰事指導；1945年雅爾塔與波茨坦會議上其擴張性的權力追求獲得成功。
body.en: In the 'Great Purge' of 1934–39 he destroyed all potential and supposed opponents, including Lenin's old Bolshevik leadership; in 1939 the USSR concluded the non-aggression pact with Germany; in 1941 he became chairman of the Council of People's Commissars and took over the conduct of the war after the German invasion; at Yalta and Potsdam in 1945 his expansionist drive succeeded.

people.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
people.nameZh: 富蘭克林·德拉諾·羅斯福

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與早期政治生涯
heading.en: Origins, schooling and early political career

body.zh-Hant: 羅斯福1882年生於紐約海德帕克，十四歲被送入格羅頓學校，後入哈佛學院，1905年在紐約市與愛蓮娜結婚。他1910年當選紐約州參議員，1912年連任；1913年進入威爾遜政府任海軍助理部長；1920年被民主黨提名為副總統候選人。
body.en: Franklin Delano Roosevelt was born in 1882 in Hyde Park, New York. At 14 his parents sent him to the Groton School, and he went on to Harvard College; he married Eleanor in New York City in 1905. He won election to the New York State Senate in 1910 and was re-elected in 1912; in 1913 he joined the Wilson administration as assistant secretary of the Navy; in 1920 the party named him its vice-presidential candidate.

heading.zh-Hant: 小兒麻痺、紐約州長與當選總統

body.zh-Hant: 1921年羅斯福罹患小兒麻痺，雙腿癱瘓；1920年代他把相當部分家產投入整修喬治亞州溫泉鎮的療養地。1928年他贏得紐約州長，1930年連任；1932年大蕭條加劇，民主黨推他挑戰胡佛總統，他以壓倒性票數當選。
body.en: Roosevelt contracted polio in 1921 and was left paralysed in his legs; he invested a considerable part of his fortune in rehabilitating a spa at Warm Springs, Georgia. He won the governorship of New York in 1928 and was re-elected in 1930. With the Depression worse by 1932 the Democrats turned to him to challenge President Hoover, and he was swept into office in a landslide.

body.zh-Hant: 他在就職演說中告訴美國人「唯一值得恐懼的就是恐懼本身」。上任後的「百日新政」推動銀行金融改革，並以電台「爐邊談話」安撫公眾。1935年新政轉向更自由主義的方向，通過《華格納法》與《社會安全法》。羅斯福在1936、1940、1944年三度連任，為美國史上唯一。義大利百科條目另指出，他延攬專家組成「智囊團」，並選柯德爾·赫爾為國務卿。
body.en: In his inaugural address he told Americans they had 'nothing to fear but fear itself'. In the First Hundred Days FDR pushed through legislation reforming banking and finance, and his radio 'fireside chats' calmed the public. In 1935 the New Deal turned in a more liberal direction with the Wagner Act and the Social Security Act. He was re-elected in 1936, 1940 and 1944, a unique case in US history. The Italian encyclopedia adds that he surrounded himself with expert advisers (the 'Brains Trust') and chose Cordell Hull as secretary of state.

body.zh-Hant: 1940至1941年間，羅斯福對抵抗納粹的英國提供大量援助。1941年12月7日日本偷襲珍珠港，美國正式參戰；到1943年，美軍與盟國已扭轉對德日的戰局。1945年4月，在德國投降前數週，他因腦出血去世。義大利百科條目記他在美國參戰很久以前就向國會發表「四大自由」咨文。
body.en: In 1940 and 1941 Roosevelt extended massive aid to Great Britain as it held out against Nazi Germany. Japan's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor on 7 December 1941 brought the United States into the war; by 1943 the US military and its allies had turned the tide against Germany and Japan. In April 1945, weeks before the German surrender, he died of a cerebral hemorrhage. The Italian encyclopedia notes his Four Freedoms message to Congress, well before the US entered the war.
